entries.subject: JWST observations of AlphaCen (programmes 1618, 6797, 9252, 12628)
entries.finding: JWST observed AlphaCen in programmes 1618, 6797, 9252, 12628 (MIRI coronagraphy, imaging and IFU), a coronagraphic search of its surroundings. The star itself is not resolved and is masked or saturated, so these give no stellar surface. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
